Results.Name: Quick decisions require PDF review, reviewer identity and authorization
Accept removes a candidate from pending and records only selected checklist evidence
Decline clears the Monthly suggestion while preserving a reviewed other PDF
Decline can identify a Daily report without accepting it as Monthly
Undo restores the previous pending state and keeps both audit entries
Undo also restores a declined candidate and rejects an unrelated old decision
A stale decision cannot overwrite another review of the same PDF
A changed saved PDF cannot be accepted or silently reclassified
A normal scanner update preserves the declined decision for unchanged source bytes
Declined PDFs export and browse as reviewed reports instead of unresolved suggestions
Undo invalidates old pending actions even when the category returns to its original value
The Windows PDF renderer produces an in-memory page without installing components
Native workspace clicks persist Accept, Undo, Decline and Skip with immediate queue updates

Scope: Synthetic saved PDFs: accept, decline, exact undo snapshots, stale decisions, source preservation, unchanged rescans and native Windows PDF page rendering.
